success_outcome: Fresh claim-linked host RED/GREEN geometry/projection evidence proves complete MM:SS and HH:MM:SS countdown values fit inside the available timer surface without clipping or overlap at 1280x720 and 2460x1080, with weather/date/city/card content hidden, the timer rail separate and the activating preset neon color preserved; focused/full regressions keep cancellation, overdue and alert audio behavior unchanged, and authorized TECNO physical evidence is PASS only when freshly observed or explicitly DEFERRED with residual risk.

The existing activating preset color identity, transparent neon ring/backdrop, separate right-side timer rail and hidden weather/date/city/card-shell countdown composition must remain intact.

Countdown cancellation, overdue transition/dismissal, audio request/start/repeat/stop, silent/DND/route suppression and platform fullscreen policy are existing read-only contracts and regression obligations.

No fixed font-size, dp, surface-size, ratio or gradient target is selected; use the canonical raw-bound measurement/tolerance method and route an unresolvable material target to feature clarification.
Physical evidence is limited to the authorized TECNO LI6 serial 1156725456009666 when available; otherwise it is DEFERRED with residual risk, and no emulator/AVD/QEMU evidence is valid.
